notes.title: Release Date Confirmed! ~ Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025 ~
notes.notes:
[h3][b]📢 [/b][i]Fruitimo![/i] will be released on[b] September 18, 2025 (Thu)! 🍓[/b][/h3][h3]
